comment: Known Crewrift Honor Society member keys — the trust ledger. Keys compare by RAW BYTES, so either base64 encoding matches. The compact HS1 form carries no pubkey on the wire, so ONLY keys listed here can be verified/trusted at all (fail-closed). A verified HS1 claim from a known key adds the color to belief.society_trusted and records belief.society_known (color -> label). alex-smith's key was re-confirmed current 2026-07-21 (17/17 live signatures verified).
